WIC25A-01.explanation: The flood drowned out the ants that raid the larvae, and the colony then raised a record number of young, so the flood protected it: it "sheltered" the colony. "Stranded" fails because the spit came back; "starved" fails because a colony raising record numbers was not short of food; "swamped" fails because an ordinary crest left the colony thriving.

WIC25A-02.explanation: The river now follows a crack that runs as true as a surveyor's line for four miles, where it once wound in wide loops: the lava "straightened" it. "Swallowed" fails because the river cut an open trench; "trapped" fails because fish still swim up from the lake, so the river still flows into it; "sidetracked" fails because it still reaches the same lake.

WIC25A-03.explanation: The crust survives only on stones from a forest that is gone, never spreads, and slowly disappears, so it is a remnant of that vanished forest: a living "vestige." "Sentinel" fails because nothing in its slow loss signals a change in conditions; "timeline" fails because patches that flake away and are never replaced record no steady time; "scaffold" fails because patches that flake off leave nothing for other plants.

WIC25A-04.explanation: The glacier lost ice through the 1950s, then advanced back over the ground it had lost and has stayed there since 1966, so the loss was "short-lived." "Sporadic" fails because the front pulled back a little each summer; "slight" fails because it lost a full kilometer; "stealthy" fails because the retreat left raw gravel in plain view.

WIC25A-05.explanation: The geese left on time but spent the winter on lakes halfway along the route and never reached the marshes, so the storms "truncated" the migration. "Staggered" fails because the flocks set off together; "spurred" fails because they left on their usual date; "swelled" fails because almost no birds arrived at the marshes.

WIC25A-06.explanation: Wrong readings confirmed a mistaken view and were used for thirty years to block research, so they held the field back: "setbacks." "Touchstones" fails because values ten times too low are no standard; "watersheds" fails because they confirmed the existing view rather than changing it; "sideshows" fails because they shaped funding decisions for three decades.

WIC25A-07.explanation: The light fell in four abrupt drops with level stretches between them, one for each cloud of dust, so the dimming was "stepwise." "Transient" fails because the clouds are still in place five years later; "shallow" fails because the light fell by half; "symmetric" fails because the star has never recovered, so nothing mirrors the fall.

WIC25A-08.explanation: In the next drought, the pines that had been through the 1950s grew almost normally while untested pines nearby barely grew, so the drought made them hardier: it "toughened" them. "Stunted" fails because their rings widened to their old breadth; "thinned" fails because the same trees are tracked through the 1970s; "sidelined" fails because they kept growing strongly.

WIC25B-01.explanation: Roadblocks and burnings gave way to roughly as many petitions before the new board, so the law "channeled" the conflict into a new course. "Deferred" fails because landowners had to answer at the next sitting. "Escalated" fails because the number of petitions matched the earlier incidents, and "entrenched" fails because both lists dwindled once grain prices fell.

WIC25B-02.explanation: With no newspaper or employment office, notices left at the stalls were sorted and handed on to the right villages, so the market served as the town's "clearinghouse." "Forum" fails because the notices were sorted and passed along, not debated. "Archive" fails because the information was current and kept moving, and "battleground" fails because nothing suggests conflict.

WIC25B-03.explanation: A feast and procession produced pledges that changed nothing in the harbors, so the agreement was above all "ceremonial." "Candid" fails because its pledges of friendship sat beside continuing seizures. "Expedient" fails because it met no practical need, since nothing changed, and "exhaustive" fails because it set no rules at all.

WIC25B-04.explanation: Furnaces were barred from the city and the workshops ended up on one island, so the guild "confined" the trade. "Doubled" fails because the duty stayed about the same. "Elevated" fails because glass remained a plain household cup, and "abandoned" fails because forty workshops kept working on the island.

WIC25B-05.explanation: The council copied and announced the court's orders and sent offenders to the court for judgment, so its authority was "ancillary" to the court's. "Coercive" fails because the court's judges, not the council, set the fines. "Customary" fails because a charter created it in 1402, and "diffuse" fails because a single steward kept its records.

WIC25B-06.explanation: The committee steered by the paper's editorials and kept to its program long after it closed, so it was the movement's "compass." "Engine" fails because its few copies went only to the committee. "Crutch" fails because the movement carried on for twenty years without it, and "epilogue" fails because it shaped campaigns while they were being fought.

WIC25B-07.explanation: Teachers retold the quarrel each year with events found in no record, so the school "embellished" the rivalry. "Defused" fails because graduates were more hostile than their parents. "Formalized" fails because the teams mixed the towns, and "commercialized" fails because its events were free.

WIC25B-08.explanation: Copied from a scheme reform clubs everywhere were praising, and celebrated with a charity ball, the program was above all "fashionable." "Frugal" fails because it paid more per family than neighbors. "Cumbersome" fails because a family applied once, and "experimental" fails because it copied an established scheme and ran unchanged until 1920.

WIC25C-01.explanation: Striking the only speeches in which the queen weighs her choice left audiences "unable to say why the queen had died," so the production "gutted" the play. "Lengthened" fails because patrons were out in good time for supper; "jumbled" fails because the scenes kept the author's sequence; "lampooned" fails because the audience left puzzled, not amused.

WIC25C-02.explanation: For forty years she quoted one dismissive sentence as proof of lazy reading, so the letter was her "grievance." "Keepsake" fails because she burned it the week it came; "lodestar" fails because she dismissed its author as a lazy reader; "lifeline" fails because editors were seeking her out.

WIC25C-03.explanation: Gold appears when a strike cut off her pigment, laid over half-finished backgrounds in hasty scraps, so its use was "improvised." "Ingrained" fails because it first appears in 1960; "incidental" fails because it covers whole backgrounds; "ironic" fails because the sitters, her friends, displayed the pictures proudly.

WIC25C-04.explanation: The 1909 pamphlet called for the very poetry that arrived a decade later, so the press "heralded" the movement. "Housed" fails because the press burned in 1910; "hindered" fails because the poets were still schoolchildren then, so it obstructed nothing; "guided" fails because none of them saw the pamphlet until 1930.

WIC25C-05.explanation: The canvas where he abandoned the academic manner, never to return to it, is his "landmark." "Hoax" fails because he signed it openly; "homage" fails because the method was one he had seen nowhere; "hybrid" fails because he scraped the whole canvas down, replacing the old manner rather than blending it.

WIC25C-06.explanation: Reducing her divorce and bankruptcy to a move to "a smaller flat" and stopping every chapter at her dressing-room door make the memoir "guarded." "Gracious" fails because her bandmates go unnamed and uncredited as "the band"; "gritty" fails because the hard years get one euphemistic sentence; "glib" fails because the prose was revised over ten years.

WIC25C-07.explanation: Turning doubt into faith and readdressing love poems so they read respectably means the niece "laundered" them. "Grouped" fails because she kept the order she found them in; "illustrated" fails because it was a plain book; "interrupted" fails because each poem had its own page.

WIC25C-08.explanation: Recycled speeches, routine cuts in revivals, and the playwright's own regret make the scene the play's "letdown." "Interlude" fails because the quarrel goes on in it; "kernel" fails because it was written during rehearsals; "hinge" fails because the house is settled only in the final act.

WIC25D-01.explanation: Small code changes made right after each complaint about freezing show that the technicians had "patched" the program. "Mothballed" fails because patrons still used it. "Outsourced" fails because the library's own technicians made the changes, and "repackaged" fails because patrons saw the same screens they had used since 1999.

WIC25D-02.explanation: The firm offered something no app had allowed and was later copied by all of them, so owners saw it as their trade's "pioneer." "Middleman" fails because restaurants kept every diner's payment themselves. "Publicist" fails because restaurants paid only a license for software, not for promotion, and "referee" fails because restaurants settled their own complaints.

WIC25D-03.explanation: Because rich and poor households paid the same amount, the fee took a far larger share from smaller incomes, so it was "regressive." "Punitive" fails because it exactly covered the cost of pickup. "Retroactive" fails because it covered pickups beginning the month after the vote, and "opaque" fails because a cost study was attached to every bill.

WIC25D-04.explanation: Later lawyers won new cases by relying on the ruling that upheld the lobster floor, so it was the state's clearest "precedent." "Pledge" fails because lawmakers let it lapse in 1980, which no lasting promise would allow. "Remedy" fails because prices were high and the floor almost never came into play, and "overreach" fails because a court upheld it.

WIC25D-05.explanation: The company licensed access, sued imitators, and kept the workings to itself, so engineers called the system "proprietary." "Modular" fails because it was a single interlocked program. "Resilient" fails because one failed disk could cost an office a day, and "outmoded" fails because it was the first to offer windows and a mouse.

WIC25D-06.explanation: Stops moved and buses took new roads, so the district had "redrawn" its routes. "Pared" fails because twelve buses still run. "Privatized" fails because the district's own drivers run them, and "monetized" fails because the savings came entirely from fuel, not new income.

WIC25D-07.explanation: The association's director made the offers across the table on the tenants' behalf, so the association was the tenants' "negotiator." "Organizer" fails because the committee had formed on its own. "Observer" fails because the director made the offers, and "mentor" fails because she did the bargaining herself and merely reported results, rather than preparing tenants to bargain.

WIC25D-08.explanation: Families got their money back when the laptops were returned, so the charge was "refundable." "Prohibitive" fails because nearly every family paid it. "Recurring" fails because it was billed once, and "misleading" fails because families were billed exactly the flyer's figure.
